accuracy.evidence: Checked for TTO: KS1 transparent/translucent/opaque definitions with torch-beam test language for clear, blurry, blocked.

misconceptions.evidence: Checked for TTO: traps for all-materials-transparent, opaque-still-readable, and translucent/opaque mix-ups in why() and adult notes.

lab_distinct.evidence: Checked for TTO: flagtto classifies materials under a beam, not light-source finding or teddy shadows (flagshadow).

lab_teaches.evidence: Checked for TTO: learner shines clear/frost/card, sorts three bins, predicts wood opaque, then challenge.

predictions.evidence: Checked for TTO: blocked=transparent and clear=opaque wrong options fall in the shine and predict steps.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked for TTO: why() separates blocked/wood/metal, clear/plastic/perf, and loud/nocolour tags with distinct lines.

readability.evidence: Checked for TTO: ages 6–7 wording keeps kid sentences short and names the three material classes plainly.

no_filler.evidence: Checked for TTO: no journey/delve filler; each line teaches a class, a torch test, or a myth to reject.

mobile.evidence: Checked for TTO: three wide sort bins and torch buttons stay tappable at 390px in the young shell.

accessibility.evidence: Checked for TTO: shine/sort/predict all have button twins; live aria-label on the canvas; challenge buttons in a labelled group.
